evidence.quote: Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Quinton commits the org to a monthly cadence by positional authority (legitimate) and frames the policy as an existential necessity — rehearsed rollback equals having rollback — appealing to a shared value of genuine readiness (inspirational-appeal).
Xena structures and supplies the record of what was decided, controlling the factual frame by curating which points count as decisions.
Xena records the decided cadence as a factual entry, exercising informational control over what the organization treats as settled.
Xena assigns ownership of the rehearsal process to Quinton by name, exercising the recorder's authority to designate an accountable party.

mints.name: ReadinessAsExistentialFraming
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is authority here being claimed by framing a capability as something that does not exist unless practiced, rather than by rank or evidence alone?
